A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReMDM work. Complete text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that the research content, including Appendices A–G, is retained. The shorter v4 removes the NeurIPS checklist rather than scientific appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original text, image and molecule generation experiments and LLaDA benchmark evaluations in Section 5 and Appendix E, including quantitative results and generated examples.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–8, experimental plots and the generated examples in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The ReMDM posterior, objective, remasking schedules and sampling procedures are identical. Algorithms 1–3 and the LLaDA adaptation in Appendix D.4 are retained unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate OpenWebText generation, ImageNet class-conditioned generation, QM9 ring-count and QED maximization, and Countdown and TruthfulQA with LLaDA. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments: AR, SEDD and MDLM-based samplers on OpenWebText; MaskGiT and MDLM on ImageNet; AR, UDLM, MDLM and the appendix FB/DFM comparisons on QM9; and LLaDA and LLaDA-DFM downstream.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D retain identical splits, preprocessing, model configurations, sample counts, metrics, sampling budgets and evaluation procedures. No existing protocol is revised and no new experiment introduces another protocol.

E4.justification: The component ablations, remasking-schedule sensitivity analyses, objective comparison, generative-perplexity hacking example and qualitative generation comparisons are all retained in Section 5 and Appendices E–F.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains identical uncertainty estimates, and Appendix D.4 still specifies 20 seeds (0–19), means and 95% confidence intervals. Checklist removal deletes the rationale for omitting error bars elsewhere, but changes neither the statistical procedures nor the reported uncertainty.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and generated examples match. For example, Table 1 retains ReMDM MAUVE of 0.656 at T=4096, and Table 3 retains LLaDA-ReMDM Countdown performance of 46.1 ± 0.2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, NELBO derivation, Theorems 3.1 and 4.1, Propositions 4.2–4.4 and proofs in Appendices A–B are unchanged. Appendix pagination changes do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about principled remasking, pretrained-model reuse, inference-time scaling, sample quality and controllable generation. The abstract changes only the project-page address.

C2.justification: Removing checklist item 7 deletes the specific explanation that computational expense and reporting conventions motivated omission of error bars outside Table 3. This loses a qualification about the empirical evidence; the substantive result interpretations and mechanism explanations elsewhere remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The project address changes from remdm.github.io to guanghanwang.com/remdm. Checklist removal also deletes the explicit statement that models and data are not released. Implementation details and asset-license tables remain unchanged; these disclosure changes do not establish changed actual resource availability.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained, including the relationships to MDLM, DDIM and predictor-corrector methods. Citations appearing in the deleted checklist refer to works still cited elsewhere.

P1.justification: v4 removes the NeurIPS checklist between the references and contents and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, section order and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Checklist removal leaves additional whitespace on the final reference page and moves the contents and appendices earlier. Figures 1–31 and Tables 1–10 retain their displays, captions and organization; there is no scientific visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The methods, proofs, experiments, results and detailed implementation information are unchanged. Removing mostly administrative checklist material simplifies the document but loses a brief explanation for missing error bars. Together with the project-address update, these limited edits leave overall scientific quality essentially unchanged.
